window.note: ONE-OFF 12-MONTH BACKFILL, not a daily run. Authorized by the tracker owner on 2026-09-16 after an audit found 117 candidates rejected on publication age (median age 48 days) across the 18 runs from 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-16. Run under the revised Step 1.1 rule: eligibility is decided by deduplication against the tracker, never by the item's age.

method: Mined all 18 existing audit logs for candidates with a parseable publication date inside the last 12 months that were never logged (101 distinct).
Cross-referenced each against data/deals_db.py by deal_id, source_url and event identity.
Ran targeted EN/KO web sweeps over the tracked-entity list to surface events no prior run had seen at all.
Screened survivors through Gates A-E with the age criterion removed.

findings.gate_e: ENHANZE licensed specifically to enable LARGER subcutaneous injection volumes for higher nimacimab dosing -- volume-per-dose is the tracker's core question.
Another ENHANZE IV-to-SC conversion on a major marketed biologic; extends the competitive benchmark for rHuPH20-enabled SC delivery.
Two of Halozyme's PH20 patents held unpatentable narrows the IP moat around the leading SC-conversion platform, changing who can operate in high-concentration SC delivery.
ALT-B4's core manufacturing patent survived Halozyme's challenge, strengthening the main competitor to ENHANZE on SC conversion.

notes: Most age-rejected candidates turned out to be genuinely already tracked -- the tracker's dedupe layer is sound; it was the age filter that was discarding real finds.
The three Merck PGR outcomes (2026-05-12, -05-15, -05-18) were consolidated into one row per the skill's event-grouping rule: same petitioner, same patent family, same week.
The entire May 2026 PTAB cluster was invisible to the tracker. It had been surfaced and age-rejected at least twice (2026-09-02 and 2026-09-16 runs) before this backfill.
No digest email was sent for this run: every finding is freshness=backfill, and the revised Step 7 rule forbids sending when there are no fresh findings.
